description: This file contains unit tests for the InterviewAttachmentAPI within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It defines test methods for CRUD operations (getAll, create, getOne, update, delete) on interview attachments, utilizing mock services and fixtures to simulate API interactions.

classes.name: InterviewAttachmentAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the InterviewAttachmentAPI endpoints related to interview attachments in the recruitment module.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all interview attachments via the API.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new interview attachment via the API.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single interview attachment by its identifier.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing interview attachment.
